headline: Problem reports can now show, not just tell
highlights: The problem-report dialog can now attach screenshots — up to three images, downscaled before they travel, for the problems words can't carry: a broken layout, a wrong colour, a control out of place.

The batch menu has Collect Filtered into a Folder…, which gathers exactly the clips the current filter and search are showing into a folder you pick. Copy is the default and leaves the originals where they are; Move relocates them and repoints the session so nothing breaks.
